differences: Set 4 control task (mouse): the paper reports a mean EHI of 72.2; the demographics sheet gives 62.7 for the 30 participants. The RT/MT rule removes 624 trials from the deposit's values where the paper reports 626 (the other nine counts per experiment match exactly).

Set 4 hand selection (A096): the paper prints 2543 excluded trials (11.0%); the authors' flags give 2453, which is 11.0% of the 22,272 trials, so the printed total is probably a transposition. All category counts match, and the total is not used as a check.

Set 3 OA control (A080): the paper's exclusion counts reproduce only when the 64 practice trials per participant are included (they are in the rows, flagged as practice). The SD of age is 1.87 (paper 1.8), and the EHI of the 6 left-handed participants is -70.0 with SD 26.9 (paper -85.8, SD 5.6; right-handed 93.5, paper 93.7); these are not used as checks.

Kinarm obstacle avoidance (A073, A074, A080): the paper's totals include trials with more than two velocity peaks, which the deposit's Error_Any flag does not contain; we flag them. Other paper sub-counts (non-smooth trajectories, movement time) are not separate columns and are not checked one by one.
In the Kinarm files the deposit records no hand for the obstacle-avoidance task, and for passive prime movements our rows leave hand_angle, rt and mt empty.
